name: Business Loan Origination (SME Term Loan)
prerequisites: BusinessCustomer record (ENT-079) must exist with status = active (created in JRN-004)
BusinessAccount (ENT-080) must be open and in good standing (JRN-004)
Business KYC/CDD current — BusinessKYCAssessment in-cycle (JRN-004). No new KYC required unless pKYC trigger fires.
Relationship Manager (PER-050) assigned to the BusinessCustomer
sub_capabilities_involved: CAP-004.01 (Credit Risk Scoring — SVC-012, cross-capability async only)
CAP-005.01 (KYC/AML — pKYC monitoring, no new CDD unless triggered)

phases.name: Loan Enquiry
phases.description: Relationship Manager (PER-050) holds initial discussion with the business customer (PER-002) to understand borrowing requirements, purpose, security availability, and indicative loan size. RM conducts a preliminary assessment using the customer's existing profile in SVC-005 (financial performance, sector, existing facilities). A non-binding indicative terms letter may be issued. No formal application is created at this stage.
actors: PER-002 (SME Business Owner / Director)
PER-050 (Relationship Manager)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — read access to BusinessCustomer, BusinessAccount)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — Affordability and Disclosure — preliminary suitability)
exit_conditions: Customer has expressed intent to proceed with formal application
RM has recorded preliminary deal notes in SVC-005 pipeline
Indicative terms communicated to customer (written or verbal)

phases.name: Loan Application
phases.description: PER-002 submits a formal loan application via the RM or business portal. SVC-005 creates a LoanApplication entity (ENT-017) with status = submitted. Customer uploads supporting financial statements (last 3 years audited accounts, management accounts, cash flow projections) and a business plan. RM validates completeness and submits to credit team. EVT-031 (LoanApplicationSubmitted) is published.
actors: PER-002 (SME Business Owner / Director)
PER-050 (Relationship Manager)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — creates LoanApplication)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 — credit application must capture data required for RWA calculation: exposure class, security type, LTV if real estate)
GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — application must record purpose, requested amount, term, repayment source)
entry_conditions: Customer has provided: financial statements (3 years), business plan, security details
exit_conditions: LoanApplication.status = submitted
EVT-031 (LoanApplicationSubmitted) published to SVC-102
EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) published to commercial.credit-assessments topic

phases.name: Credit Assessment
phases.description: SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) receives EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) and runs automated credit scoring: Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision under IFRS 9 and Basel 3.1 IRB approach. SVC-012 publishes EVT-033 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) with risk_rating and pd_score. Back in SVC-005, a Credit Analyst (PER-056) receives the automated score and prepares a full credit paper incorporating sector analysis, management quality, financial ratios, and security valuation. The CreditAssessment entity (ENT-018) is created with the analyst's narrative and risk rating.
actors: SVC-012 (Risk Engine — automated PD/LGD/EAD scoring)
PER-056 (Credit Analyst — manual review and credit paper)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — stores CreditAssessment)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 Output Floor — IRB parameters: PD, LGD, EAD must meet PRA PS17/23 standards)
GOV-005-R01 (commercial CDD — confirms KYC clearance still current before credit assessment proceeds)
entry_conditions: Financial statements and business plan available in SVC-005 document store
exit_conditions: CreditAssessment entity (ENT-018) created with risk_rating, pd_score, lgd_estimate, ead, ecl_provision
EVT-033 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) received by SVC-005 from SVC-012
Credit Analyst has completed credit paper and submitted to underwriting

phases.name: Underwriting
phases.description: For loan amounts above the Relationship Manager's credit authority threshold, the credit paper is referred to the Credit Committee for approval. The committee reviews risk rating, proposed pricing (margin over SONIA), security structure, and covenant package. Committee may approve, approve with conditions, or decline. For amounts within RM authority, RM/Senior RM approves directly. EVT-034 (LoanApproved) or EVT-035 (LoanDeclined) is published. For conditional approvals, conditions precedent are recorded on the facility record.
actors: PER-050 (Relationship Manager — approvals within RM authority)
PER-056 (Credit Analyst — presents credit paper)
Credit Committee (for amounts above RM credit authority threshold)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — records committee decision on CreditAssessment.committee_decision)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 — credit committee must approve the risk-adjusted pricing and capital allocation for the facility)
GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — decline must be communicated in writing with rationale where required)
entry_conditions: PH-018 completed — CreditAssessment entity populated with risk_rating and analyst sign-off
Credit paper presented to appropriate approval authority per credit policy
exit_conditions: CreditAssessment.committee_decision = approved | approved_with_conditions | declined
EVT-034 (LoanApproved) or EVT-035 (LoanDeclined) published
Customer notified of decision in writing (GOV-002-R05)

phases.name: Facility Agreement
phases.description: Following credit approval, the bank's legal team issues a Facility Agreement (ENT-019) to the business customer. The agreement specifies: approved amount, interest rate (SONIA + margin), repayment schedule, security requirements, financial covenants (e.g. minimum DSCR, maximum leverage ratio), and conditions precedent to drawdown. PER-002 reviews, negotiates if required, and signs. Conditions precedent (e.g. debenture, personal guarantee, charge registration at Companies House) are tracked and perfected. EVT-036 (FacilityAgreed) is published on signing.
actors: PER-002 (SME Business Owner / Director — signs the agreement)
PER-050 (Relationship Manager — coordinates legal documentation)
Legal Team (prepares and negotiates facility agreement)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — creates FacilityAgreement entity)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 — security perfection affects LGD calculation; security must be legally enforceable for IRB credit risk mitigation recognition)
GOV-002-R02 (ETDA 2023 — facility agreement may be executed as an electronic document under ETDA-compliant platform)
GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — standardised cost of credit disclosure in offer letter; APRC-equivalent required)
entry_conditions: EVT-034 (LoanApproved) received — credit committee approval confirmed
All conditions precedent identified and communicated to customer
exit_conditions: FacilityAgreement.signed_date populated
All conditions precedent satisfied and recorded
EVT-036 (FacilityAgreed) published
Security registered at Companies House (for qualifying charges under Companies Act 2006 s.859A)

phases.name: Drawdown
phases.description: Customer requests drawdown of some or all of the approved facility. SVC-005 verifies all conditions precedent are met, creates a LoanAccount (ENT-020) for the facility, and instructs SVC-009 (Domestic Payments Service) to credit the drawdown amount to the customer's BusinessAccount (ENT-080). CHAPS is used for same-day settlement for amounts above the BACS threshold. EVT-037 (LoanDrawnDown) and EVT-038 (LoanAccountOpened) are published. The LoanAccount is linked to the FacilityAgreement and begins accruing interest from the drawdown date.
actors: PER-002 (SME Business Owner / Director — initiates drawdown request)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — creates LoanAccount, instructs payment)
SVC-009 (Domestic Payments Service — executes CHAPS/BACS credit to BusinessAccount)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 — LoanAccount.outstanding_balance is the EAD input for ongoing capital calculation; must be reported to SVC-012 via event for RWA updates)
GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — drawdown instruction triggers cooling-off rights check if applicable)
entry_conditions: All conditions precedent confirmed as satisfied
Drawdown request received from PER-002 with drawdown amount and destination account
exit_conditions: LoanAccount.status = active
LoanAccount.outstanding_balance = drawdown amount
Funds credited to BusinessAccount via SVC-009 (CHAPS same-day)
EVT-037 (LoanDrawnDown) published
EVT-038 (LoanAccountOpened) published

phases.name: Ongoing Monitoring
phases.description: Post-drawdown, SVC-005 monitors covenant compliance throughout the loan term. Financial covenants (e.g. minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio, maximum Gross Leverage) are tested at agreed intervals (typically quarterly or semi-annually) using financial information submitted by the borrower. CovenantMonitoring entities (ENT-021) record each test result. Automated early-warning signals flag deterioration in the borrower's trading account turnover or missed repayments. Annual reviews are conducted by the RM and Credit Analyst. EVT-039 (CovenantBreachDetected) is published on any covenant failure, triggering internal escalation and borrower notification.
actors: PER-002 (SME Business Owner / Director — submits periodic financial information)
PER-050 (Relationship Manager — annual review)
PER-056 (Credit Analyst — reviews covenant test results, prepares watch-list papers)
SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core — automates covenant testing, monitors BusinessAccount activity)
SVC-012 (Risk Engine — re-scores PD on annual review events via async event)
governance_rules: GOV-002-R01 (Basel 3.1 — annual review triggers LGD and PD re-estimation; IFRS 9 staging must be assessed at each reporting date)
GOV-002-R03 (BBRS — borrower in financial difficulty must be offered BBRS access within complaint handling)
GOV-002-R05 (FCA SME Lending Rules — forbearance obligations; arrears and distress policies apply)
exit_conditions: All covenants tested and recorded in CovenantMonitoring (ENT-021) per schedule
EVT-039 (CovenantBreachDetected) published if any covenant breached
Annual review completed with updated risk rating and CreditAssessment record
Journey terminates at loan maturity/full repayment or event of default

happy_path.description: Customer applies for a term loan. Credit Assessment produces a satisfactory risk rating. Credit Committee approves. Facility Agreement signed. Full drawdown on day one. Covenants tested quarterly — all pass throughout term.

alternative_paths.name: Within-RM-Authority Approval
alternative_paths.description: Loan amount falls within the Relationship Manager's individual credit authority. PH-019 is abbreviated — RM approves directly without credit committee referral. All other phases unchanged.

alternative_paths.name: Conditional Approval — Conditions Precedent Outstanding
alternative_paths.description: Credit Committee approves subject to conditions precedent (e.g. personal guarantee from directors, first charge debenture). PH-020 extends until all CPs are satisfied. Drawdown (PH-021) is blocked until CP clearance is confirmed.

alternative_paths.name: Partial Drawdown
alternative_paths.description: Customer draws only a portion of the approved facility at PH-021. Remaining facility is available for future drawdown. Multiple drawdown events may occur. Each drawdown publishes a separate EVT-037.

alternative_paths.name: Covenant Breach — Waiver
alternative_paths.description: A covenant breach is detected in PH-022 (EVT-039). RM engages customer. Credit Committee grants a formal waiver. LoanAccount remains active with revised covenant terms. Waiver documented in FacilityAgreement conditions.

exception_paths.name: Credit Decline
exception_paths.description: CreditAssessment in PH-018 produces a risk rating above the bank's acceptable threshold. Credit Committee in PH-019 declines. EVT-035 (LoanDeclined) published. LoanApplication.status = declined. Customer notified in writing with right of appeal. No FacilityAgreement or LoanAccount is created.

exception_paths.name: Application Withdrawn by Customer
exception_paths.description: Customer withdraws the application at any point before FacilityAgreement signing. LoanApplication.status = withdrawn. Any partially-completed CreditAssessment is archived. No events beyond EVT-031 are published.

exception_paths.name: Covenant Breach — Event of Default
exception_paths.description: A material covenant breach is not waived. The bank issues a formal demand. LoanAccount.status = default. Legal enforcement of security begins. EVT-039 escalates to enforcement workflow (outside scope of JRN-007 — handled by Collections journey).

design_decisions.decision: Business Lending (CAP-002.02) is modelled as a RETAINED sub-capability within CAP-002 and implemented entirely within SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core). There is no separate 'Business Lending Service'.
design_decisions.rationale: Business lending is tightly coupled to the commercial customer ledger (ENT-079, ENT-080) and requires direct read access to customer financials, account behaviour, and existing facility records held in SVC-005. Promoting to a separate service would require cross-service API calls within the same capability domain, adding latency and complexity with no architectural benefit. The nCino lending origination workflow is embedded within the SVC-005 commercial core implementation.

design_decisions.decision: Credit risk scoring (PD/LGD/EAD/ECL) is owned exclusively by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004). SVC-005 requests assessment via async event (EVT-032) and receives the result via async event (EVT-033). No synchronous API call crosses the CAP-002 / CAP-004 boundary.
design_decisions.rationale: Cross-capability synchronous calls create tight coupling and cascade failures. The risk engine (SVC-012) must independently evolve its IRB models without SVC-005 API contract changes. Basel 3.1 IRB model change notification (PRA PS17/23) requires the credit scoring capability to be independently versioned. Async events ensure SVC-005 is never blocked by SVC-012 latency, and allow multiple consumers to subscribe to CreditAssessmentCompleted without coupling (e.g. SVC-104 data platform for portfolio analytics).

design_decisions.decision: KYC/CDD is treated as already completed (JRN-004 prerequisite). No new CDD is initiated in JRN-007 unless SVC-014's perpetual KYC monitoring triggers a re-screening event.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 Regulation 30 allows CDD completed at onboarding to be relied upon for subsequent product applications where there is no change in customer risk profile. Repeating CDD at each product application creates unnecessary customer friction and MLRO resource demand. JRN-007 depends on JRN-004 having produced a current BusinessKYCAssessment.

design_decisions.decision: LoanAccount (ENT-020) is a distinct entity from BusinessAccount (ENT-080). The loan is tracked in a separate account record linked via business_customer_id FK; the drawdown disbursement is a credit to the BusinessAccount via SVC-009.
design_decisions.rationale: A business may have multiple concurrent loan facilities alongside its current account. Conflating them would prevent multi-facility structures and complicate IFRS 9 staging (each facility requires independent ECL assessment). LoanAccount carries loan-specific fields (outstanding_balance, next_payment_date, status) that are not applicable to a transactional current account.

design_decisions.decision: Personal guarantees from directors create a reference to SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001) via event subscription only. SVC-005 records the personal guarantee detail within FacilityAgreement.conditions_precedent as a string field referencing the guarantor's individual customer_id. No FK join to ENT-001 (Customer) in SVC-005.
design_decisions.rationale: Personal guarantees are a legal instrument, not an operational data dependency at runtime. Storing a reference string is sufficient for legal documentation purposes. Creating an FK relationship from a CAP-002 entity to a CAP-001 entity (ENT-001) would violate the cross-capability data isolation principle (SDD-009 — only the Data Platform may aggregate across capability domains).
